description: Authoring tool: generate a t-shirt-size ladder of bundles, then price it per cluster. Reusable — re-apply pricing when a new cluster onboards (final-plan-pricing.md §11, issue #33).

fields.label: Start vCPU
fields.description: Smallest rung, in vCPU (1 vCPU = 1000 millicores). The ladder doubles from here.

fields.label: Ceiling vCPU
fields.description: Largest rung. The ladder doubles from start up to (and including) this.

fields.label: Memory Ratio
fields.description: GB RAM per vCPU — 1:2 standard, 1:4 high-memory. A pre-fill; edit a generated Plan to go off-ratio.

fields.label: Base Disk (GB)
fields.description: Disk for the smallest rung; scales with size. 0 = no disk line.

fields.label: Plan Name Prefix
fields.description: Generated plan names start with this (e.g. "Bundle 2 vCPU 4 GB").

fields.label: Base Rate
fields.description: Price of the smallest rung. Each rung is priced base_rate × its size multiplier.

fields.label: Default Cluster
fields.description: Blank = a global rate (available on every cluster). Set a region key to price only there.

fields.options: Generate creates the bundles and prices them for the currency + default cluster above. Use Apply Pricing to Cluster to add a new cluster's rates over all or a selected subset of these plans — a plan is sellable on a cluster only where it has a rate (or a global one).

name: Plan Configurator
